title: Management box — now
description: Is the management box doing something, and how far is it? Lifecycle from the box's mgmt_* + the in-flight upgrade leases; progress and outcome from cluster truth (operator ruling 2026-10-11, docs/management-box.md).

options.content: **The management box (the R12 out-of-band applier, [docs/management-box.md](https://github.com/teststuffstash/homelab/blob/master/docs/management-box.md)) — is it doing something, and how far is it?** **Now** reads the box's own `mgmt_*` series (job `mgmt-node`) and the in-flight ⚓ upgrade leases (`upgrade_lease_*`, the cluster-side reader) — LIFECYCLE only: started, working, stopped on something, which applies are in flight. **Progress (cluster truth)** reads what the cluster says — ArgoCD Application health+sync, the running versions from kube-state-metrics, the `management-apply` commit status on master via github-exporter — the operator ruling of 2026-10-11: the box reports lifecycle, the cluster reports progress and outcome. **History (7d)** replays the Mgmt*/UpgradeLease* alerts as a state timeline (markers, not notifications; the belts live in `argocd/resources/mgmt-metrics/` + `upgrade-lease-reader/`).

panels.title: Now — the box's lifecycle (mgmt_* = box self-report; leases = cluster-side reader)
In-flight applies — ⚓ upgrade leases (upgrade_lease_info ⋈ started / expected end / max end)
panels.description: One row per standing lease ConfigMap as the 2-min cluster-side reader (argocd/resources/upgrade-lease-reader/) publishes it to the Pushgateway group upgrade_lease_probe. Empty = nothing in flight. Time left = expected end − now (negative = past its deadline: UpgradeLeasePastExpectedEnd).

targets.expr: upgrade_lease_started_timestamp_seconds * on (lease, subject) group_left (by, chart, from, to, sha) upgrade_lease_info
upgrade_lease_expected_end_timestamp_seconds * on (lease, subject) group_left (by, chart, from, to, sha) upgrade_lease_info
upgrade_lease_max_end_timestamp_seconds * on (lease, subject) group_left (by, chart, from, to, sha) upgrade_lease_info
(upgrade_lease_expected_end_timestamp_seconds - time()) * on (lease, subject) group_left (by, chart, from, to, sha) upgrade_lease_info

panels.title: Leases standing
panels.description: upgrade_lease_standing from the cluster-side reader; absent = UpgradeLeaseProbeAbsent.

panels.title: Last OK apply tick — age
panels.description: time() − mgmt_apply_last_ok_tick_timestamp_seconds. The 5-min apply loop's last tick that ended OK; >15 min = MgmtApplyLoopStale territory.

panels.title: Unapplied on master
panels.description: mgmt_apply_unapplied_commits (+ the oldest's age from mgmt_apply_unapplied_oldest_timestamp_seconds). 0 = master applied.

panels.title: Deferred / stopped / refused
panels.description: mgmt_apply_deferred_window / _deferred_verdict / _helm_stopped / _refused / _post_check_failed — each 1 while the box is stopped on that reason.

panels.title: Box loops — last-run age
panels.description: time() − mgmt_lease_last_run_timestamp_seconds / mgmt_reconcile_last_run_timestamp_seconds / mgmt_probe_last_run_timestamp{mode=belt|gate}. No mgmt_sentinel_* series exists — the sentinel (ADR-131) is not scraped.

panels.title: Fleet rollout (reconciler)
panels.description: mgmt_reconcile_rollout_stage{target,kind,stage} == 1 (canary|fleet|done|halted) and mgmt_reconcile_rollout_halted{reason} == 1. Both exist only while a fleet rollout runs.

panels.title: Reconciler — nodes not idle
panels.description: mgmt_reconcile_node_state{node,state} == 1 for state ≠ idle (pending | syncing | parked).

panels.title: Progress (cluster truth) — ArgoCD, kube-state-metrics, github-exporter: what the cluster says the apply did
ArgoCD apps Healthy+Synced
panels.description: argocd_app_info — every Application the app-of-apps manages (the box's argocd / argocd-apps helm applies land here).

panels.title: ArgoCD apps NOT Healthy+Synced (argocd_app_info)
panels.description: argocd_app_info where health_status ≠ Healthy or sync_status ≠ Synced. Empty = the platform converged after the apply.

panels.title: management-apply status on master (github-exporter)
panels.description: github_mgmt_apply_refused / _refused_since_timestamp / _outside_addresses — the box's `management-apply` commit STATUS on master, read by github-exporter. Absent = the loop has not posted a verdict on HEAD (absent ≠ zero, by design). The belt is MgmtApplyResidueStanding.

panels.title: Substrate minors behind upstream
panels.description: mgmt_substrate_minors_behind{component} — the box's upstream-release read (the one box-side number here that is not lifecycle: how far the cone is from upstream, the MgmtSubstrateBehind belt).

panels.title: Running versions (cluster truth)
panels.description: cilium_version{version}, argocd_cluster_info{k8s_version}, kube_pod_container_info{image_spec} for argocd-server and longhorn-manager — the `to` side of a lease as the cluster actually runs it. Two values for one component = an apply mid-rollout.

panels.title: Longhorn volumes per engine image (kube_longhorn_volume_engine_info)
panels.description: count by (spec_image, current_image) — a Longhorn upgrade's engine-image rollout: progress = volumes moving from the old current_image to the new one. One row = converged.

panels.title: History (7d) — the Mgmt*/UpgradeLease* alerts as markers, lease starts, the apply loop
Mgmt* / UpgradeLease* alerts (ALERTS, firing = red, pending = orange)
panels.description: max by (alertname) (ALERTS{alertname=~"UpgradeLease.*|Mgmt.*"}) — firing weighs 2, pending 1. UpgradeLeaseInFlight is the what-is-in-flight marker (info, never notified); the rest are the belts.

panels.title: Leases in flight over time
panels.description: upgrade_lease_standing (the reader's count) beside the box's mgmt_lease_active / mgmt_lease_expired — a gap between them is a box that vanished mid-bracket (UpgradeLeaseOrphaned).

panels.title: Apply loop — last-OK-tick age and unapplied commits
panels.description: time() − mgmt_apply_last_ok_tick_timestamp_seconds (a sawtooth every 5 min is the loop ticking OK; a ramp is a stopped loop) and mgmt_apply_unapplied_commits on the right axis.

panels.title: Lease loop outcomes per hour (mgmt_lease_revert_total)
panels.description: increase(mgmt_lease_revert_total[1h]) by outcome — forward_only is the normal confirm path; reverted / conflict / error are the lease loop acting or failing (MgmtLeaseRevertFailed).
